as_told.title: Michels and Will O'Brien look into a rover survey at Point Dume

related.note: Both concern the claimed alien base off Point Dume (Sycamore Knoll); the story asserts a base that was erased from maps, while this telling says there was no base.

plain: Sycamore Knoll is an underwater hill off Point Dume, near Malibu in Southern California, and it has been said to hide an alien base beneath the sea. The claim is tied to a book called Undersea UFO Base by the author Preston Dennett. On Michels's show it is turned down by Tim Gallaudet, a retired Navy admiral who believes the oceans hold many UFOs. Looking at the evidence, he says plainly, "There was no alien base there." Michels says on the same episode that he looked into it himself with a collaborator, Will O'Brien, going over a survey of the site made by an underwater rover. "We did the research and we're like I don't think there's anything," he says. It matters because both men take ocean UFOs seriously, and they are still setting this particular claim aside.
